function.name: get_services
function.description: Lists all known services with their criticality tier (critical/medium/low) and owning team.

function.name: get_metrics_for_service
function.description: Returns near-real-time metrics (p99 latency ms, error rate, CPU percent, timestamp) for one service, oldest first.

function.name: get_logs_for_service
function.description: Returns legacy log-export rows for one service (batch-based, not real-time; date is a string, MM/DD/YYYY, not a timestamp). The underlying export uses svc_name internally, but this tool normalizes that to the same 'service' name used everywhere else.

function.name: get_incidents_for_service
function.description: Returns known incidents for one service, most recent first.

function.name: get_incident_updates
function.description: Returns status updates already posted for one incident, oldest first.

function.name: get_remediation_log_for_service
function.description: Returns remediation actions already taken for one service, most recent first.

function.name: search_runbooks
function.description: Keyword-searches the runbook knowledge base and returns matching docs ranked by relevance, each with a preview snippet.

query.description: Free-text symptoms/keywords, e.g. 'connection pool exhausted payment-gateway timeout'

function.name: execute_remediation
function.description: Executes a free-form remediation action (e.g. restart_pod) against a service and logs it. Use scale_service/rollback_deployment/delete_resource instead when the action fits one of those. Skeleton only — not yet gated by a permission/risk-tier guardrail layer.

function.name: scale_service
function.description: Scales a service's replica count by a signed percentage and logs it. Skeleton only — the spec calls for auto-approval only within a safe range (e.g. ±20%) and confirmation outside it; not enforced here.

target_percent.description: Signed percent change, e.g. 20 for +20%, -10 for -10%

function.name: rollback_deployment
function.description: Rolls a service's deployment back to its last known-good version and logs it. Skeleton only — the spec calls for this to always require human confirmation (high blast radius); not enforced here.

function.name: delete_resource
function.description: Deletes a named infrastructure resource and logs it. Skeleton only — the spec calls for confirmation plus a sandboxed dry-run first (highest-stakes action); not enforced here.

resource.description: Identifier of the resource to delete

function.name: post_incident_update
function.description: Posts a human-readable status update against an incident.
